ads_queries.harvest_lesson_HL1: THE FOUR-FORM QUERY MISSED THE BURST'S OWN DEDICATED PAPER. Iyyani+2015 (2015MNRAS.450.1651I, 'Extremely narrow spectrum of GRB110920A') was returned by NONE of the four required forms, because its title and text write the name WITHOUT A SPACE and WITH the suffix ('GRB110920A'), and the trigger id appears nowhere in it. I found it only through a chained citation inside Li 2019, then recovered it with a FIFTH form, full:"GRB110920A". RECOMMENDATION for LiteratureHarvest.md Phase 1: make the no-space+suffix form ('GRBYYMMDD[A/B]') a mandatory FIFTH query form.
